title: Paloma Business Treasury Ruling: Holding Back ACH Credit Deposits on Withdrawal
content:
On a withdrawal from a Paloma Business balance, how ACH credit deposits are held back depends on the whole months since KYB approval and on the ACH credit deposits received in the twelve months before the day of the withdrawal, counted from the day after the same calendar day twelve months earlier up to and including that day. The amount held back is not withdrawable.

### Ruling

An account approved at least 36 whole months earlier with six or more ACH credit deposits in that window has nothing held back; an account approved at least 12 whole months earlier with two or more ACH credit deposits in that window that does not meet both of those conditions has the most recent ACH credit deposit held back only on the day it is received; every other account has the most recent ACH credit deposit held back while fewer calendar days than the plan's ACH hold days have passed since it was received.

### Truth table

| Whole months since KYB approval | ACH credit deposits in the twelve months | Held back |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | 6 or more | Nothing |
| 36 or more | 2 to 5 | The most recent ACH credit deposit, on the day it is received only |
| 12 to 35 | 2 or more | The most recent ACH credit deposit, on the day it is received only |
| 12 or more | 0 or 1 | The most recent ACH credit deposit, while fewer calendar days than the plan's ACH hold days have passed |
| Fewer than 12 | Any number | The most recent ACH credit deposit, while fewer calendar days than the plan's ACH hold days have passed |

### Cases (hypothetical; plan ACH hold of 3 days; most recent ACH credit deposit 5000.00 USD received 10 March)

| Account | Withdrawal on | Held back |
|---|---|---|
| 40 whole months since approval, 8 ACH credit deposits | 10 March | Nothing |
| 20 whole months, 4 ACH credit deposits | 10 March | 5000.00 USD |
| 20 whole months, 4 ACH credit deposits | 11 March | Nothing |
| 8 whole months, 4 ACH credit deposits | 12 March | 5000.00 USD: 2 days have passed |
| 8 whole months, 4 ACH credit deposits | 13 March | Nothing: 3 days have passed |
